subject: OrbitAI onboarding: marketplace registration, PO workflow & forms
messages:
From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@orbitai.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace onboarding & PO steps (OrbitAI)

Hi Chloe / Redwood team,

Thanks for the intro last week. We're ready to start the marketplace onboarding for OrbitAI (we're targeting AWS and Azure first; GCP later). Procurement asked me to collect the following so we can issue a PO and get your listing live: 

- Vendor intake form (to create vendor record)
- Tax paperwork (W-9 for US) or VAT registration guidance for EU sales
- Your preferred remit/payable address and invoicing email
- Marketplace-specific billing preferences (consolidated billing through AWS Marketplace vs. direct invoicing)
- Any standard MSA or marketplace terms we should review

I've attached our procurement questionnaire to this message with a few fields marked for Redwood to complete. Timeline: OrbitAI wants a listing and initial procurement commitment by the end of March.

Can you confirm next steps and who on your finance/legal side will be the point person? Also, if you have a standard PO template or any Marketplace-seller guidance we should follow, please share.

Thanks,
Anna Gomez
Head of Procurement, OrbitAI
anna.gomez@orbitai.com
Attachments: OrbitAI_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 246 KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@orbitai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace onboarding & PO steps (OrbitAI)

Hi Anna — great to hear, thanks for the doc.

Quick summary / proposed mutual action plan so we can keep OrbitAI's timeline: 
1) I attach our Redwood Vendor Intake Form and an internal checklist for Marketplace activation. Please complete the vendor form and return it (we can accept DOCX or the DocuSign powerform linked below).
2) For US customers we require a W-9. If OrbitAI will sell into EU customers via marketplace, we can accept your VAT registration details instead; Marissa, can you confirm VAT evidence requirements?
3) PO flow options: 
   - AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing): OrbitAI issues a PO to Redwood or uses the AWS private offer flow; AWS invoices and remits to us via their marketplace settlement. If you prefer consolidated billing, confirm whether OrbitAI will use its AWS billing payer account (we need the AWS Account ID).
   - Direct invoicing (preferred by some enterprise customers): OrbitAI issues a PO to Redwood; invoices sent to procurement@orbitai.com; net30 standard unless otherwise negotiated.
4) Marketplace listing details we need from OrbitAI (SKU, pricing model: subscription vs metered, expected first-month usage estimates) — this helps us advise on pricing/PO structure.

Next steps I recommend:
- OrbitAI fills the attached Vendor Intake Form + returns W-9 or VAT docs (we can accept upload to the Drive link below or return by email).
- We (Redwood) will provision the seller record in AWS and Azure Seller consoles in parallel and confirm any private offer requirements.

DocuSign powerform (vendor intake): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&po=12345
Drive upload folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample/onboarding-packets

I've cc'd Vanessa (marketplace activation) and Rishi (finance) to confirm PO and invoicing details; Marissa is looped for VAT/tax.

If that plan works, Anna, can you return the vendor form and the Questionnaire by EOD Wed, Mar 11? We'll hold an internal 24-hour turnaround on the account creation to meet your end-of-month goal.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.docx (docx, 72 KB); Redwood_Marketplace_Internal_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 34 KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Redwood marketplace onboarding & PO steps (OrbitAI) 

Vanessa / Rishi — forwarding OrbitAI's procurement questionnaire and my proposed next steps. Key asks:

- Vanessa: can your team run the Seller Console activation in AWS + Azure in parallel once OrbitAI returns the vendor form? Any lead time we should flag?
- Rishi: confirm whether Redwood will accept PO net30 from OrbitAI for marketplace-sourced subscriptions (we may need to record a private-offer acceptance flow for AWS). Also advise on who the billing contact should be (finance@redwood.com or billing@redwood.com).
- Marissa: VAT evidence — if OrbitAI flags EU customers, what docs do we need to validate VAT registration for marketplace transactions?

Notes / constraints I flagged to OrbitAI: we typically accept both consolidated marketplace billing and direct PO; consolidated billing sometimes requires a private offer or AWS registration details which can affect timeline by ~3 business days. If OrbitAI wants a private offer, we must get their AWS Account ID and a signed private-offer doc (can be routed via HubSpot).

Can you please reply with the single point of contact for finance and an ETA? OrbitAI is targeting end of March, so we need to move quickly.

Thanks — Chloe

From: procurement@orbitai.com <procurement@orbitai.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@orbitai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace onboarding & PO steps (OrbitAI)

Chloe / team — thanks for the clear plan. We attached a draft PO (Draft_PO_OrbitAI_000123.pdf) and completed the vendor intake form fields in the questionnaire PDF (see attached). A few clarifications inline below: 

On Wed, Mar 9, 2026 at 10:15 AM Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) I attach our Redwood Vendor Intake Form and an internal checklist for Marketplace activation. Please complete the vendor form and return it (we can accept DOCX or the DocuSign powerform linked below).

Attached: we uploaded a signed PDF of the vendor intake answers and the PO draft. Please confirm receipt.

> 3) PO flow options:
>    - AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing)
>    - Direct invoicing (preferred by some enterprise customers): OrbitAI issues a PO to Redwood; invoices sent to procurement@orbitai.com; net30 standard unless otherwise negotiated.

We prefer consolidated billing through AWS Marketplace if possible — OrbitAI will provide the AWS Payer Account ID once you confirm the private-offer routing. If consolidated billing is not feasible for a first-month pilot, we will issue the attached PO (Draft_PO_OrbitAI_000123.pdf) to Redwood with net30.

Next: please confirm the remit address and invoicing email so we can update the PO. Also confirm whether we should attach the private-offer paperwork to the AWS Seller Central onboarding or send it to legal@redwood.com for review.

Thanks,
OrbitAI Procurement Team
procurement@orbitai.com
Attachments: Draft_PO_OrbitAI_000123.pdf (pdf, 18 KB); OrbitAI_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (updated, 260 KB)
